backend/main.mo: Motoko actor with a single public function `submitContactForm` that accepts name, email, and message parameters but currently performs no action (placeholder for future email/notification integration).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features that replaced the 'Vedic Study Circles' program card title and description with Hindi text in the Programs page.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing the Sanatani-themed React application with custom styling, routing, components, and pages including the Hindi text updates to the Vedic Study Circles program card.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color palettes using OKLCH color system, including Sanatani-inspired warm colors and design tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA', root div, and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for Home, About, Programs, Contact, and Donate pages, all wrapped in a Layout component.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying organization logo, quick links, contact information, social media icons, and attribution with dynamic year and caffeine.ai link with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image overlay, organization name, Sanskrit tagline, mission statement, call-to-action buttons, and animated scroll indicator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper component that renders Navigation header, main content outlet, and Footer for consistent page structure.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section displaying four core values (Devotion, Protection, Knowledge, Unity) in a grid with icons, titles, and descriptions using traditional Sanatani styling.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation header with organization logo, desktop/mobile menus, active route highlighting, and sticky positioning with backdrop blur.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying program information with icon, title, and description, featuring hover effects and consistent styling.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Displays a grid of four support option cards (Volunteer, Spread Awareness, Contribute Skills, Share Knowledge) with icons, descriptions, and links to the contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor with authentication, automatically switching between anonymous and authenticated actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Custom hook that handles contact form submission by calling the backend actor's submitContactForm method and managing submission state (loading, success, error).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing identity state, AuthClient creation, and delegation validation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks that interact with the backend; currently contains only example structure and comments.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles with Tailwind CSS, custom CSS variables for a Sanatani-inspired warm color palette (saffron, terracotta, gold), font imports (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), and utility classes for patterns and gradients.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page component displaying the organization's story, purpose, vision, values, and community principles in a hero section, narrative text, and grid of principle cards with icons.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a form for submitting messages (using useContactForm hook), contact information cards (email, phone, location), and social media links with submission state handling.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donate page component with hero section, support options, impact areas breakdown (cultural programs, education, community service, heritage preservation), and transparency commitment section.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Homepage component featuring Hero, Mission, 'What We Do' highlights (cultural preservation, spiritual education, community building, social service), and call-to-action section with support/contact links.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Programs page displaying six program cards (Vedic study, festivals, youth education, community gatherings, social welfare, heritage preservation) with hero section and impact statistics.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, Sanatani-themed colors (saffron, terracotta, gold), custom fonts (Inter, Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel), shadows, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting completed features for KATTAR SANATANI YODHA non-profit website including homepage, about, programs, contact, donate sections, and cultural theme implementation.
